breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the planar second moment of area I (not the polar moment J) in the curvature formula κ = M/(E·I). It explicitly states 'Do not use the polar second moment J anywhere in the calculation,' directly correcting the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt that suggested using J. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which simply uses I in the standard Euler-Bernoulli bending formula.
